name: Valley of Hinnom
line: The Valley of Hinnom is a deep, narrow ravine near Jerusalem that marked tribal borders and later became a picture of the place of the wicked.

moments.title: Border of Judah
moments.text: The border of Judah's land went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites, which is Jerusalem. It then climbed to the top of the hill facing the Valley of Hinnom.

moments.title: Border of Benjamin
moments.text: Benjamin's southern border ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and on to En-rogel.

moments.title: People settle to the valley
moments.text: After the Exile, people of Judah settled in towns all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
